title: Undo forgets the layers
hints: Undo works for `title` and `zoom` but not for anything inside `layers`. Inside `commit`, log `draft === this.current` and `draft.layers === this.current.layers`.

`commit` hands the recipe a *copy* to scribble on, so the snapshot pushed to `past` stays untouched. But the copy only goes one level deep: the new draft and the old snapshot still share the same `layers` array and the same layer objects.
Give the recipe a deep copy: `const draft = structuredClone(this.current);`
